assets.telchine: Use case: style-transfer. Production SNES pixel-art atlas for Theseus. Reference1 is the teal Greek soldier and source layout, Reference2 Theseus is anatomy and pixel-detail quality. Create a DOG-HEADED SEA DAEMON Greek warrior with the same human soldier body proportions, teal/sea-green tunic, bronze greaves and shoulder armor, leather belt, warm grey-blue skin/fur, clearly canine pointed ears, dark nose, projecting dog muzzle, visible eye and small teeth. This is a humanoid Greek soldier with a dog head, NOT a four-legged dog, not a cute pet, not a human wearing a dog mask. Short bronze trident gripped firmly in both hands, melee only, never thrown. EXACTLY SEVEN separate full-body RIGHT-facing poses in ONE HORIZONTAL ROW, equal scale and foot baseline: 0 left-leg-forward walk,1 low passing step,2 opposite contact,3 opposite low passing step,4 planted trident windup,5 short stationary two-handed forward jab,6 withdrawn trident recovery. EXACTLY TWO LEGS/TWO FEET, knees below hem, natural low steps, attached arms and hands. Target72x56 cells,504x56 sheet, standing46px, foot row53, body pivotx36. Weapons fully within each cell. Original colored palette like references, strong light/dark material shading and readable dog head at native size. True transparent alpha, no scene, ground, shadows, labels or frame borders. Keep the pose layout of reference1 but REPLACE the human head with a convincing dog head in EVERY pose; no flasks, no ranged effects.
assets.spartoi: Use case: style-transfer. Production SNES pixel-art atlas for Theseus. Reference1 is the red Greek Raider for animation layout and clothing; Reference2 Theseus gives pixel scale and quality. Create a Greek SKELETON WARRIOR: ivory skull with dark eye sockets and clearly shaped jaw/teeth, exposed shaded rib cage and bony arms/legs with visible knee joints, bronze Greek helmet with muted red crest, worn bronze shoulder plates/greaves, leather belt and ragged dark red skirt/cape. Skeleton anatomy MUST be clear in all poses; no flesh face or skin-colored legs. Keep readable thick shaded bones rather than stick figures. Short iron kopis sword always held in one hand. EXACTLY SEVEN right-facing full-body poses in ONE HORIZONTAL ROW: four natural low-knee walking poses, then planted sword windup, low forward sword lunge, exhausted recovery. Match Raider's sequence and 72x56 cell contract;504x56 sheet,46px standing height, foot row53, body pivotx36. Two legs and two feet per pose, attached arms, same costume and scale across frames. All weapons within cells. True transparent background, crisp fine square pixels, detailed material ramps, no blur, no motion trails, no fire, no scenery, labels, shadows or frame lines.
assets.stymphalian_bird: Use case: stylized-concept. Production four-frame pixel-art flying enemy atlas for the Theseus SNES-style Greek side-scroller. Reference images show the existing Greek warriors' pixel scale and bronze palette only. Create a recognizable mythological Stymphalian bird: dark teal feathered body, small red eye, sharp long bronze beak, bronze-edged metallic wing feathers, short tail, two tucked talons. Side view facing RIGHT, alert and dangerous, not a generic flat icon or a giant eagle. EXACTLY FOUR separated flying poses in ONE HORIZONTAL ROW with full wings visible: wing raised, forward mid stroke, shallow downstroke, trailing recovery. Stable body core at the same height in every frame. MOST wing motion is above the core; lowest feather and tucked talon remain at the same baseline, no dangling legs. Intended native size about32px wide by20px tall, in72x56 cells; body core centered x36 y28, lowest visible pixel y32. Transparent gaps between all four figures. Fine shaded dark teal and bronze ramps, clear beak/eye/individual feathers that read at native size and belong beside these detailed warriors. Target288x56 sheet. True transparent alpha, no arrows or feather projectiles, no scenery, text, grids, ground shadows or blur.

packing.method: Godot Image API: transparent pose extraction, nearest-neighbor normalization and atlas packing; no drawn replacement artwork.
